maddeler.e:
تخادمت (form VI)
# تَخَادَمْتُ (taḵādamtu) /ta.xaː.dam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَخَادَمَ (taḵādama)
# تَخَادَمْتَ (taḵādamta) /ta.xaː.dam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَخَادَمَ (taḵādama)
# تَخَادَمْتِ (taḵādamti) /ta.xaː.dam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَخَادَمَ (taḵādama)
# تَخَادَمَتْ (taḵādamat) /ta.xaː.da.mat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
